title: Going to space
content: For awhile I was having reoccurring dreams that I was building and maintaining a ufo, but it was kinda shitty. Went to mars and broke down and had to get help fixing it I think. Ever since I've owned this ufo and in the dreams I've had occasional space dramas. One time visited I think a mallworld in space. One time helped with some kind of dark portal black hole thing that was out of control. Most often just use the ufo to just avoid the various apocalypses that beset our DreamWorlds. I've lost it recently and been basically only exploring the underground layers anyone ever had experiences like this?
